claims.text: Doxycycline = first-line for adults (incl preg pts) and children; azithro or cipro if doxy resistance.
claims.quote: Doxycycline is recommended as first-line treatment for adults (including pregnant patients) and children. If resistance to doxycycline is documented, azithromycin and ciprofloxacin are alternative options

claims.text: Children < 12 y: doxy 2 to 4 mg/kg as 1 single dose;
claims.quote: for children < 12 years old, 1 single dose of 2 to 4 mg/kg
for children < 12 years old, 1 single dose of 20 mg/kg (maximum 1 g)
Ciprofloxacin: For patients ≥ 12 years old, including pregnant patients, 1 single dose of 1 g; for children < 12 years old, 1 single dose of 20 mg/kg (maximum 1 g)
